PJA 0.9.9 (tag v0.9.9, commit 62bf00c), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.9.9-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
41965cdf5ef4dc18abde7ea7684be3ef414d9bc15ce22bda83d00b6e19de7b74, as its
SHA256SUMS says; each of its 43 source and license files also compared
with the tag's: all the same), copied unmodified. 0.9.9 writes the same
streams as 0.9.8; its BLAKE3 comes from B3's pBLAKE3 (pas/b3chunks.c, the
same hash). Before it, PJA 0.9.8 (PMPA 0.4.0 to 0.5.0), 0.6.3 (0.3.x) and
0.6.2 (0.2.0).

On the 55 real MP3 covers of PMPA's measurement set, 0.9.8 (and 0.9.9)
write the very same streams as 0.6.3: PMPA's stream version stays 8. What PMPA gains: the
fixes since 0.6.3, and pjamodel.GetSimd/SetSimd with pjav7.V7Retable, so
that pmpa --cpu reaches the covers' model (plain, sse41, avx2).

PMPA uses it for the JPEG pictures of ID3v2 tags (album covers): pjacodec.
Compress with version 7's model, pjacodec.Decompress. The JPEG 2000 units
come along (pjacodec uses them) and are never called. MIT (LICENSE);
NOTICE has PJA's third-party notes; VENDOR.md is PJA's note for zpaq-std.

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
